vetSays.line: ★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Amina was watching. Now they know Ground Elder too.
📚 Village knowledge: Sarah taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Sarah showed Nora the Ground Elder — "remember it." Word gets around.
Olivia showed Ingrid the Ground Elder — "remember it." The haven hears about it by supper.
Naree showed Zhigang the Ground Elder — "remember it." Word travels before the lesson cools.
Amina showed Leo the Ground Elder — "remember it." Word gets around.
Leo showed Nikolai the Ground Elder — "remember it." Word travels before the lesson cools.
🛡️ Amina, Olivia, Nora and Nikolai met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Amina, Olivia, Nora, Nikolai are hurt.
Sarah drew Ground Elder in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.
🛡️ Amina, Olivia and Nora met them at the door — 3 put down. Amina, Olivia, Nora are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🌿 Ground Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 Ground Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.

📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village.
